channel_identity.binding_note: The internal slug is retained because existing production artifacts and commands use it. This experiment applies only to the listed Manhwa Joey YouTube identity.

runtime.rule: Aim through story scope and narration pace. Do not select or reject a completed draft merely because of word count.

advertising.placement_rule: Move each target to the nearest clean scene or movement boundary within 90 seconds. Never place a break inside a sentence, reveal, confrontation, action exchange, or emotional payoff.

within_video_ad_cliff_control.ad_positions_source: the exact three manual_mid_roll_positions_sec values bound into the publish manifest
within_video_ad_cliff_control.calculation: For each ad position, compare the 90-second retention drop centered on the insertion with equal-width adjacent 90-second drops. Record the excess local drop in percentage points; do not infer causality from the whole-video APV change.
within_video_ad_cliff_control.availability_rule: Attempt the curve capture at 24h, 72h, and 7d. If YouTube has not exposed a usable curve, record unavailable with a reason rather than fabricating values, and try again at the next checkpoint.
within_video_ad_cliff_control.interpretation_rule: An ad-aligned excess drop is evidence of possible interruption friction. It is not proof that every viewer received an ad or that ads explain the video's total retention.

measurement.segmentation_rule: Exclude Shorts and compare longform by traffic source, subscriber status, duration, release age, impressions, and packaging. Use the within-video ad-aligned cliff control to separate local interruption signals from premise-level performance as far as the available YouTube data permits.

completion_rule: After three eligible uploads have mature 72-hour snapshots, compare the cohort before changing the ad policy. Keep collecting the 7-day snapshots after the initial decision.
rollback_rule: Deactivate this experiment after its third eligible upload. Do not silently extend it to a fourth upload.
